topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I didn’t think it was possible, but there he was, caught in a web of his own making. We’ve known each other for years, and all this time, he’s been spinning tales about his job. The prestigious firm, the corner office, the board meetings—it was all just a mirage. I stumbled upon the truth by accident, a chance conversation that peeled back the layers. Now, I’m standing here, pieces of our conversations falling into place, wondering how I didn’t see the cracks before. The silence between us feels different now, heavy with the weight of unspoken words. How do you confront a friend about a lie that’s been woven so tightly into the fabric of your friendship?
